name: Disneyland Plaza Inn Herb-Baked Salmon Fillet with Mashed Potatoes or White Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Plaza Inn (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Plaza Inn's counter rotation routinely includes a tender baked salmon fillet alongside the fried chicken and pot roast—giving you a 9.0/10 non-fried omega-3 meal with whipped potatoes and a warm biscuit.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the Baked Salmon with mashed potatoes (no gravy) and a biscuit, holding any lemon-caper sauce.
watchOuts: Take a lactase tablet for the mashed potatoes and skip any lemon garnish
